title: Seasons.
logline: A year on the island in one minute: everything changes colour, nothing gets lost.

story.setup: The island turns through its seasons: each of Rotli's six theme families, light and dark.
story.turn: The quokka tries on colours, glasses, a hat (or turns the companion off); a new friend opens the Welcome folder's nine lessons and the guided tour.
story.payoff: At sunset the quokka and the Librarian look out over the island: everything kept.

features.claim: Six theme families, each with a tuned light and dark environment.
Pick a body colour, black or white linework, a mood and pose, and glasses or a bucket hat in any colour. Turn the companion off and it appears only during onboarding.
The Welcome folder holds nine short lessons, plus a guided tour of the real controls. Settings → General → Show me around runs it again.

scenes.template: montage: the six families as seasons (visits every atmosphere)
